dedupe_keys.name: global semiconductor manufacturing water withdrawals 1 020 fabs

description: This Purdue dataset and web map estimates water withdrawals of 1,020 semiconductor fabrication facilities worldwide. It gives each fab's direct manufacturing water use (fab feedwater, tier 1) and the water withdrawn to generate the electricity it uses (tier 2), and weights them by the AWARE water scarcity factor of the watershed. Fab locations and production data come from SEMI, the industry association that tracks current and planned fabs; feedwater is estimated with technology-specific water use factors from Boyd (2012) and Sematech (2001 to 2013), and electricity water intensity from government data and literature. Kali Frost and Inez Hua published it on 26 February 2019 as version 1.0 under CC0; the five files (about 1 MB) include CSV tables and an embedded ArcGIS map, and access is free. Caveats: withdrawals are modelled from factors, not reported, SEMI's underlying fab list is proprietary, and the data reflect the 2019 release. For simulation it locates water-intensive chip fabs and their exposure to water scarcity, useful to test how drought or water supply cuts would hit semiconductor supply chains. Related catalogue records include the global industrial water use dataset, the USGS industrial water use estimates and the Aqueduct water risk data where catalogued.
